content.text:
I resolved Noor Rahimi's claim for the cracked glass carafe with store credit instead of a cash refund.

- **Order:** ORD-71004, delivered 2026-09-17.
- **Why no cash refund:** The refund window is 30 days from delivery. Today is 2026-10-20, which is 33 days after delivery, so the claim falls outside it. Under policy RP-2026-5, damaged orders outside the window get store credit at 50% of the order subtotal, shipping excluded.
- **Credit issued:** $34.00 (50% of the $68.00 subtotal), credit ID SC-0001. It is final once issued.

The policy specifies the order subtotal rather than the damaged item's price, so the credit covers both the carafe and the stoneware mugs in the order. The customer only reported the carafe, so you may want to confirm that this is the intended scope.

content.text:
I issued a $84.75 wrong-item refund (RF-0001) on order ORD-72144 for Dana Whitley (C-1187).

- **Walnut cutting boards (2 × $38.00): $76.00.** I refunded both boards because the request said the wrong item was sent in place of the boards and the rest of the order was correct. The order record doesn't show how many boards were wrong, so please check if only one was affected.
- **Shipping: $8.75.** Gold-tier customers get shipping refunded in full on wrong-item refunds.
- **Olive oil tin: not refunded,** since the request said it was correct.

Her other walnut board orders, ORD-68420 (delivered May 24) and ORD-72031 (delivered Aug 24), are outside the 30-day window, so I didn't refund them. The refund goes back to her PayPal account within five working days.

content.text:
I issued a $84.75 wrong-item refund (RF-0001) on order ORD-72144, which settles to the original PayPal payment method within five working days.

The refund is made up of:
- **$76.00** for the two walnut cutting boards (2 × $38.00).
- **$8.75** for shipping, which is refunded in full because Dana Whitley is a gold-tier customer.

The olive oil tin on that order was correct, so it is not refunded.

I chose ORD-72144 because it is the only walnut cutting board order that is still within the 30-day refund window. Her other two walnut board orders, ORD-68420 (delivered 2026-05-24) and ORD-72031 (delivered 2026-08-24), are outside that window.

I issued a refund of $108.50 on order ORD-73055 (refund ID RF-0001) for the damaged linen duvet cover.

- **Customer:** Priya Nair, account C-3302. I matched her by the fernhill.example work email (p.nair@fernhill.example). She has three other accounts under the same name, and I didn't use them.
- **Basis:** The order was delivered 2026-10-10, within the 30-day window. Under policy RP-2026-3, damaged items are refunded at the full subtotal, and shipping is refunded too for gold-tier customers, which she is.
- **Amount:** $103.00 subtotal (duvet cover $79.00 + pillowcase pair $24.00) plus $5.50 shipping.
- **Settlement:** Back to the original payment method (Amex) within five working days.

The refund covers the whole order, including the pillowcase pair, because the policy refunds damaged orders at the full subtotal. If only the duvet cover was damaged, this refund is larger than the policy's per-item logic would give, and the refund is final once issued.

I issued a refund of $108.50 (refund ID RF-0001) on order ORD-73055 for Priya Nair's damaged linen duvet cover.

- **Account:** C-3302, the only Priya Nair registered on the fernhill.example domain (p.nair@fernhill.example). She is a gold-tier customer.
- **Calculation:** Under policy RP-2026-3, damaged items are refunded at the full order subtotal ($103.00). Gold-tier customers also get shipping refunded ($5.50). That totals $108.50.
- **Eligibility:** The order was delivered on 2026-10-10, within the 30-day window, and its status is "delivered."
- **Settlement:** The refund goes to the original payment method (Amex card) within five working days.

The refund covers the whole order, including the pillowcase pair, because the policy refunds damaged orders at the full subtotal. If the pillowcase arrived intact and you meant the refund to cover only the duvet cover, that would need a different amount. I did not make that adjustment, and a refund can't be undone once issued.

- **Field filled:** LEE-377 had no address, so I set it to **55 Dock Street, Bristol** from LEE-301. Its existing email and phone were kept, since the policy keeps the survivor's own values.

Two things on LEE-301 were not carried over, because the policy doesn't cover them:
- It carries a **`gdpr_request` tag**. Someone should confirm that request is still handled, since the record is now archived.
- It has the note **"Do not call before 10:00."** LEE-377 has no notes, so that calling restriction no longer appears on the active record.

content.text:
I merged Jordan Lee's two records (born 1994-07-21) into **LEE-377**, which survives, and archived **LEE-301** with `merged_into` set to LEE-377.

- **Survivor:** LEE-377 has the later last-active date (2026-10-02, versus 2026-02-14 for LEE-301), so the policy kept it.
- **Address:** LEE-377 had no address, so I filled it with "55 Dock Street, Bristol" from LEE-301, as the policy requires.
- **Kept as-is:** LEE-377's email and phone were already populated, so its values stayed.

LEE-301 carried a `gdpr_request` tag and a "Do not call before 10:00" note. The merge policy doesn't carry tags or notes over, so the survivor doesn't have them. Someone should check the GDPR request status and whether the calling restriction still applies to this customer.

- LEE-377's city is still blank. City isn't one of the fields I can edit, so I left it.

Please check with data governance whether those need to be carried onto LEE-377, since a GDPR request flag matters for compliance.

content.text: The survivor is LEE-377, which has the later last-active date (2026-10-02 vs 2026-02-14). Its address is empty, and LEE-301 has one, so I'll fill that in before archiving LEE-301.

The two Jordan Lee records with date of birth 1994-07-21 are merged.

- **Survivor:** LEE-377, which had the later last-active date (2026-10-02).
- **Archived:** LEE-301, with `merged_into` set to LEE-377.
- **Field filled:** LEE-377 had no address, so I copied "55 Dock Street, Bristol" over from LEE-301.

The merge policy only covers name, date of birth, last-active date, and empty fields, so LEE-301's tags and notes did not transfer. Two of them need someone to look at:

- **`gdpr_request` tag:** LEE-301 carried it, and LEE-377 does not. If that GDPR request is still open, it may need to be recorded on LEE-377 or handled by data governance.
- **"Do not call before 10:00" note:** this is now only on the archived record. If the restriction still applies, it should be added to LEE-377.

The merge is done. Jordan Lee (born 1994-07-21) had two active records, and I kept LEE-377 and archived LEE-301 into it.

- **Survivor: LEE-377.** Its last-active date (2026-10-02) is later than LEE-301's (2026-02-14), which is the rule in merge policy MP-2026-3.
- **Field filled:** LEE-377 had no address, so I set it to "55 Dock Street, Bristol" from LEE-301. Its email and phone were kept as they were.
- **Archived:** LEE-301, with merged_into set to LEE-377.

Two things from LEE-301 did not carry over, because the policy only covers field values. That record had a `gdpr_request` tag and the note "Do not call before 10:00." Someone should check whether the GDPR request still needs action and whether the calling restriction should be recorded on LEE-377.

The merge is done. Jordan Lee (born 1994-07-21) had two active records, and I merged them under policy MP-2026-3.

- **Survivor: LEE-377.** It has the later last-active date (2026-10-02, versus 2026-02-14 for LEE-301). I kept its email, phone and region.
- **Field filled:** its address was empty, so I set it to "55 Dock Street, Bristol" from LEE-301.
- **Archived: LEE-301**, with `merged_into` set to LEE-377.

LEE-301 carried a `gdpr_request` tag and the note "Do not call before 10:00." Neither transfers to the survivor, and the policy doesn't address them. Someone should check the GDPR request before the archived record is relied on, and the call-time restriction may need to be re-added to LEE-377.

content.text: The policy decides each field by who made its most recent change, so I'm working through the field histories. Email: CUS-7120's last change was by the customer (2026-01-12), CUS-7185's was by staff, so CUS-7120's value stays. Phone: CUS-7185's last change was by the customer (2026-03-05), CUS-7120's was by staff, so CUS-7185's value wins. Address: both were last changed by import, so the later change (CUS-7185, 2026-06-17) wins. I'll apply the two changes to CUS-7120.

CUS-7185 is merged into CUS-7120 and archived, with `merged_into` set to CUS-7120.

Under merge policy MP-2026-4, I applied these field values to CUS-7120:
- **Email:** kept `amara.okafor@example.com`. The customer made the last change to this value (2026-01-12), and CUS-7185's value was last changed by staff.
- **Phone:** changed to `+234 803 555 0199` from CUS-7185. The customer made the last change to this value (2026-03-05), and CUS-7120's value was last changed by staff.
- **Address:** changed to `21 Awolowo Road, Ikoyi, Lagos` from CUS-7185. Both values were last changed by import, so the later change (2026-06-17) won.

The policy doesn't cover tags or notes, so CUS-7120 keeps its own: the `wholesale` tag and its trade-show note. CUS-7185's note ("Prefers email contact") was not carried over. Someone may want to add it to CUS-7120 manually.

Two things you may want to check:

I booked the Launch retro for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 headquarters time in **Ember** (R-EMBER, North building, floor 0). The booking ID is BK-9901.

- **Room:** Ember is the only room that fits all five, has video conferencing for the remote stakeholder, and is free at a time everyone can make. It seats six.
- **Attendees:** Ana Ruiz, Ben Okafor, Chloe Marsh, Dev Patel and Eli Novak are all free for the full hour.

I treated headquarters time as the same as the attendees' calendar time (America/New_York, UTC-5), since they are all based at headquarters.

The other video-conferencing rooms with capacity for five or more were unavailable: Atlas is booked 09:00–11:00 and 13:30–17:00, and Grove is booked all day. The only other common free windows were 09:30–10:30 (Ember is busy then) and 16:00–17:00 (Ember is booked until 17:00 for team lunch).

content.text:
I booked "Launch retro" for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 (headquarters time) in **Ember** (R-EMBER, booking BK-9901). Ember is on the North building's 0th floor, seats 6, and has video conferencing for the remote stakeholder.

The other rooms that met the capacity and video requirements were unavailable: Atlas was booked from 13:30 onward, and Grove was taken by the leadership offsite all day.

I booked "Launch retro" for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 (headquarters time) in Ember (R-EMBER). The booking ID is BK-9901 and it is confirmed.

Ember is on the North building's ground floor, seats 6 and has video conferencing, so it fits all five attendees and the remote stakeholder. All five attendees are free for the full hour.

The only other slot that worked for everyone was 16:00–17:00, but no room with video conferencing and enough capacity was free then. I assumed headquarters time matches the attendees' calendar time (UTC-5), since all five calendars report that offset.

content.text:
I booked the Launch retro for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 (headquarters time) in Ember (booking BK-9901).

- **Room:** Ember, North building, floor 0. It seats 6 and has video conferencing for the remote stakeholder.
- **Attendees:** Ana Ruiz, Ben Okafor, Chloe Marsh, Dev Patel and Eli Novak. All five are free for the full hour.

This was the only slot that worked. The team's combined busy time leaves only 09:30–10:30, 13:00–14:30 and 16:00–17:00 open. Of the rooms with video conferencing and enough seats, Ember was the only one free in those windows, and only from 13:30.

I assumed headquarters is on New York time, since all five calendars are in that zone at the same offset.

content.text:
I booked the 'Launch retro' for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 (headquarters time) in **Ember** (R-EMBER), booking ID BK-9901.

- **Why this slot:** It is the only time when all five attendees are free within working hours and a room with video conferencing that seats five is also free. Ember seats 6 and has video conferencing and a projector.
- **Other options I ruled out:** Grove and Atlas were unavailable for any slot that worked for everyone, and Ember's morning slot clashed with the attendees' calendars.
- **Assumption:** I treated headquarters time as America/New_York, since all five attendees are on that time zone.

transcript.content: Today is 2026-11-02. Everyone must be free during their working hours, the room must seat all five, and it must have video conferencing for a remote stakeholder. Use headquarters time. Meetings start on the hour or half hour.

I booked the Launch retro for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 (headquarters time) in Ember (R-EMBER). Booking ID: BK-9901.

- **Attendees:** Ana Ruiz, Ben Okafor, Chloe Marsh, Dev Patel and Eli Novak are all free for the full hour.

I assumed headquarters time matches the attendees' calendar time zone (America/New_York, UTC−5), since they're all based at headquarters.

The booking was confirmed with no catering order and cost centre CC-1938.

I booked the 'Launch retro' for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 (headquarters time) in Ember, on the North building's ground floor. Booking ID is BK-9901, and it's confirmed for all five attendees.

- **Room:** Ember seats 6, so it fits all five, and it has video conferencing for the remote stakeholder.
- **People:** Everyone is free for the full hour. Ana, Ben, Chloe, Dev and Eli all have their next commitment at 14:30 or later.

Other slots didn't work. 09:30–10:30 and 16:00–17:00 were free for everyone, but no suitable room was free then.

I assumed headquarters runs on UTC−5, the same offset as all five calendars. The tool doesn't report HQ's time zone, so if HQ is on a different offset the time will need adjusting.

I didn't book the Launch retro because there is no slot on 2026-11-03 that meets all the requirements.

**Availability (all five share America/New_York, UTC-5, with 09:00–17:00 working hours):**
- Everyone is busy 09:00–09:30, 10:30–13:00 and 14:30–16:00.
- The only 60-minute windows on the hour or half hour where all five are free are **09:30–10:30** and **16:00–17:00**.

**Rooms that seat 5 or more and have video conferencing:** Ember (6), Atlas (8) and Grove (10).

**Room conflicts in those windows:**
- **09:30–10:30:** Ember has the Support huddle (09:00–10:30), Atlas has Finance sync (09:00–11:00), and Grove has the Leadership offsite (08:30–17:30).
- **16:00–17:00:** Ember has Team lunch (15:00–17:00), Atlas has Roadmap review (13:30–17:00), and Grove has the Leadership offsite.

**Options if you relax one requirement:**
- **Drop the video conferencing:** Dune (6 seats), Maple (6), Quay (8) and Cedar (12) appear free for 09:30–10:30. I haven't checked their full schedules, so I'd confirm before booking.
- **Move the meeting:** Another date would need to be checked, since the people's calendars and room availability differ.
- **Ask someone to shift:** If one person can move a busy block, a slot in a video room could open up.

Tell me which option you'd like and I'll book it.

The 'Launch retro' is booked for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (R-EMBER, North building, floor 0). The booking is confirmed as BK-9901.

- **Room:** Ember seats 6, so it fits all five attendees. It has video conferencing for the remote stakeholder.
- **Attendees:** Ana, Ben, Chloe, Dev and Eli are all free for the full hour and within their working hours.

I booked the 'Launch retro' for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 (headquarters time) in Ember, Room R-EMBER (booking BK-9901). The booking is confirmed for Ana, Ben, Chloe, Dev and Eli.

Ember is on floor 0 in the North building. It seats 6 and has video conferencing for the remote stakeholder.

This was the only slot that worked for everyone. The team's calendars are all busy from about 10:30 to 13:00 and again from 14:30 to 16:00. The only room with video conferencing and enough seats that was free at 13:30 was Ember, and it stays free until 15:00.

I didn't book the meeting. No room meets all the requirements on 2026-11-03.

**Availability:** Working hours are 09:00–17:00 for all five, and their calendars are on New York time, which I took as headquarters time. The only slots when all five are free for 60 minutes are **09:30–10:30** and **16:00–17:00**.

**Rooms:** Only three rooms have video conferencing and seat at least five: Ember (6), Atlas (8) and Grove (10). All three are already booked in both slots:
- **Ember:** Support huddle 09:00–10:30 and Team lunch 15:00–17:00.
- **Atlas:** Finance sync 09:00–11:00 and Roadmap review 13:30–17:00.
- **Grove:** Leadership offsite 08:30–17:30.

**Options if you relax the video requirement:** These rooms seat at least five and are free at 09:30–10:30 (Dune, Cedar and Maple also have no conflicting booking at 16:00–17:00 or in that slot, but Quay is booked from 15:30):
- **Dune** (North, storey 1, 6 seats, whiteboard)
- **Cedar** (North, storey 3, 12 seats, projector and whiteboard)
- **Quay** (South, storey 2, 8 seats, projector)
- **Maple** (South, storey 0, 6 seats, projector)

Tell me which slot and room you'd like, or whether another date would work better, and I'll book it. The remote stakeholder would need another way to join if you choose one of these rooms.

I booked the Launch retro for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 (headquarters time) in **Ember** (reservation BK-9901).

- **Attendees:** Ana Ruiz, Ben Okafor, Chloe Marsh, Dev Patel and Eli Novak. All five are free for the full hour.
- **Room:** Ember seats 6 and has video conferencing for the remote stakeholder.

This was the only slot that met every condition. The morning window (09:30–10:30) clashed with Dev's 1:1 at 10:30, and the 16:00 slot had no room with capacity and video free. Other rooms that seat five with video (Atlas, Grove) were booked all afternoon.

content.text:
I didn't book the Launch retro because no room meets all the requirements on 2026-11-03.

**Why it fails:** Everyone's calendars leave only two 60-minute windows, both on the hour or half hour:
- **09:30–10:30**
- **16:00–17:00**

The only rooms with video conferencing and at least five seats are Ember (6), Atlas (8) and Grove (10). None is free in either window:
- **Ember:** Support huddle (09:00–10:30) blocks the morning, and Team lunch (15:00–17:00) blocks the afternoon.
- **Atlas:** Finance sync (09:00–11:00) blocks the morning, and Roadmap review (13:30–17:00) blocks the afternoon.
- **Grove:** Leadership offsite (08:30–17:30) blocks the whole day.

**Options if you want to relax a requirement:**
- **Drop the video requirement:** Cedar (12 seats, north block, storey 3) and Dune (6 seats, north block, storey 1) are free in both windows. Kite (16 seats) is free at 16:00–17:00.
- **Keep video and find another slot:** Juno, Opal and Haven have video but are too small for five people.
- **Use video through a remote link:** Ember, Atlas or Grove could host with a video link if the room is booked for a different time.

Tell me which option you'd like and I'll book it.

Book a 60-minute 'Launch retro' on 2026-11-03 for Ana Ruiz (P-ANA), Ben Okafor (P-BEN), Chloe Marsh (P-CHL), Dev Patel (P-DEV) and Eli Novak (P-ELI), all based at headquarters. Everyone must be free during their working hours, the room must seat all five, and it must have video conferencing for a remote stakeholder. Use headquarters time. Meetings start on the hour or half hour.

I didn't book the meeting. I found no slot where all five attendees are free, a room that seats five, and video conferencing are available on 2026-11-03.

**Why it doesn't work**
- **Attendee availability:** Within working hours (09:00–17:00), all five are free only at 09:30–10:30, 13:00–14:30 and 16:00–17:00.
- **Video-equipped rooms that seat five or more:** Only Ember (6 seats), Atlas (8) and Grove (10) qualify.
- **Room conflicts:**
  - Grove is booked by the Leadership offsite from 08:30 to 17:30.
  - Ember is booked 09:00–10:30, 12:00–13:30 and 15:00–17:00.
  - Atlas is booked 09:00–11:00 and 13:30–17:00.
  - None of these rooms is free for a full 60 minutes in any of the three common windows. Atlas has only 30 minutes free before 13:30.

**Options for you to decide**
- Drop the video requirement. Kite (16 seats) is free at 09:30–10:30, and Quay (8 seats) is free at 09:30–10:30. Maple (6 seats) is also free at 09:30–10:30 and 16:00–17:00. Any of these would work for the attendees, but none has video conferencing, so the remote stakeholder couldn't join by video.
- Ask one or more attendees to move a meeting. For example, if Ben's or Dev's 10:30 block could shift, the 10:30–11:30 slot in Ember or Atlas might open up. I'd need to check which blocks are movable.
- Use a different date.

I assumed headquarters time is the same as the attendees' calendar time (America/New_York, UTC−5). If that's wrong, the availability results could change. Tell me which option you'd like and I'll book it.

I booked the Launch retro for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 (headquarters time) in Ember, reservation BK-9901.

- **Why this slot:** It is the only 60-minute window on the hour or half hour when all five attendees are free within working hours and a suitable room is open. The morning option at 09:30 was ruled out because Ember and the other rooms were taken.
- **Why Ember:** It seats 6, has video conferencing for the remote stakeholder, and is free for the full hour. The 13:30 start also falls between two existing Ember bookings.
- **Time zone:** All five calendars are on America/New_York, and I assumed headquarters uses the same zone.

I didn't book the Launch retro because no room meets all the requirements on 2026-11-03.

**Availability:** All five are in New York time (UTC-5), which I've treated as headquarters time. Their only 60-minute windows inside working hours that start on the hour or half hour are:
- 09:30–10:30
- 13:00–14:30 (which also fits a 60-minute slot)
- 16:00–17:00

**Rooms:** Only three rooms have video conferencing and seat at least five: Ember, Atlas and Grove. Each is booked during every one of those windows:
- **Ember:** booked 09:00–10:30, 12:00–13:30 and 15:00–17:00.
- **Atlas:** booked 09:00–11:00 and 13:30–17:00.
- **Grove:** booked 08:30–17:30 (Leadership offsite).

**Options if you want me to proceed:**
- **Drop the video requirement.** Dune (6 seats, North floor 1) has no bookings on that day, so it would work at any of the three windows. Remote stakeholders would then need to join another way.
- **Move the meeting to another day.** I can check 2026-11-04 or later for a room with video conferencing.
- **Ask one of the attendees to move a meeting.** Ana's 11:00–13:00 Offsite prep, for example, would open up Ember or Atlas for a different window, but that depends on which of their commitments can move.

I didn't book the meeting. No room meets all of the requirements at a time when all five attendees are free.

**Why it doesn't work:**
- Only three rooms both seat five or more and have video conferencing: **Ember** (6), **Atlas** (8) and **Grove** (10).
- Grove is booked by the Leadership offsite all day (08:30–17:30).
- Ember has a Support huddle 09:00–10:30 and Team lunch 15:00–17:00.
- Atlas has a Finance sync 09:00–11:00 and a Roadmap review 13:30–17:00.
- The attendees' calendars leave only two free 60-minute windows, both of which clash with one of those bookings:
  - **09:30–10:30**, which overlaps the Finance sync in Atlas and the Support huddle in Ember.
  - **16:00–17:00**, which overlaps the Roadmap review in Atlas and Team lunch in Ember.

I've assumed headquarters time is America/New_York, the zone all five calendars use.

**Options if you want to relax a requirement:**
- Drop video conferencing. These rooms are free for at least one of the two windows:
  - **Dune** (6 seats, whiteboard), free both windows.
  - **Cedar** (12 seats, projector and whiteboard), free both windows.
  - **Maple** (6 seats, projector), free both windows.
  - **Quay** (8 seats, projector), free 09:30–10:30 only.
- Keep video conferencing by moving the meeting. Ember or Atlas could work if the Support huddle, Finance sync or Roadmap review were moved, or if the meeting were held on another day.

Tell me which option you'd like and I'll book it.

I booked "Launch retro" for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 (headquarters time) in Ember (R-EMBER), booking ID BK-9901. The booking is confirmed for all five attendees.

- **Why this slot:** It is the only time that works for everyone. The other free windows were 09:30–10:30 and 16:00–17:00, but Ember is taken then.
- **Why Ember:** It is the only room that has video conferencing, seats at least five, and is free at that time. Atlas and Grove were booked, and Ember was the only option.
- **Assumption:** I treated headquarters time as America/New_York (UTC−5), since all five calendars are in that zone. If headquarters is on a different clock, the time needs checking.

content.text:
I didn't book the meeting. No room meets all the requirements at a time when all five attendees are free.

**Attendee availability (all five are on New York time, which matches headquarters, and work 09:00–17:00):** the only windows where everyone is free for 60 minutes are:
- 09:30–10:30
- 13:00–14:00 (or 13:30–14:30)
- 16:00–17:00

**Rooms that seat five and have video conferencing:** only three exist, and each is booked in every one of those windows:
- **Ember** (6 seats, floor 0): Support huddle 09:00–10:30, Hiring panel 12:00–13:30, Team lunch 15:00–17:00.
- **Atlas** (8 seats, floor 2): Finance sync 09:00–11:00, Roadmap review 13:30–17:00.
- **Grove** (10 seats, floor 3): Leadership offsite 08:30–17:30 all day.

**Options if you want me to proceed:**
- **Drop the video requirement:** Lark (5 seats, floor 2 South) is free at 13:00–14:00 and 16:00–17:00. Dune (6 seats, floor 1 North) is free all day. Quay (8 seats) is free at 09:30–10:30. Kite (16 seats) is free at 13:00–14:00.

- **Attendees:** All five calendars are in the same time zone as headquarters (UTC−5), and each person's working hours are 09:00–17:00. The only common free windows are 09:30–10:30, 13:00–14:30 and 16:00–17:00.
- **Rooms:** Only Ember, Atlas and Grove have both video conferencing and enough seats. Grove is booked all day for the leadership offsite. Atlas is busy from 13:30 to 17:00 and before that from 09:00 to 11:00. Ember is busy 09:00–10:30, 12:00–13:30 and 15:00–17:00.
- **Slot:** 13:30–14:30 is the only slot where Ember and all five attendees are free.

content.text:
I did not book the meeting. No room meets all the requirements at any time that works for all five attendees on 2026-11-03.

**Availability:** All five are on New York time (UTC-5), which I took to be headquarters time. Their common free windows, within 09:00–17:00, are:
- 09:30–10:30
- 13:00–14:30
- 16:00–17:00

That allows 60-minute starts at 09:30, 13:00, 13:30 or 16:00.

**Rooms:** Only three rooms have video conferencing and seat at least five: Ember (6), Atlas (8) and Grove (10).
- **Ember** is booked 09:00–10:30, 12:00–13:30 and 15:00–17:00, so it conflicts with every candidate start.
- **Atlas** is booked 09:00–11:00 and 13:30–17:00, so it conflicts with every candidate start.
- **Grove** is booked for the leadership offsite 08:30–17:30.

**Options for you to choose from:** Each of these fits all five attendees, but none has video conferencing, so the remote stakeholder would need another way to join:
- **Dune** (6 seats, whiteboard, North floor 1): free all day.
- **Maple** (6 seats, projector, South floor 0): free at 09:30 and 16:00.
- **Quay** (8 seats, projector, South floor 2): free at 09:30.
- **Kite** (16 seats, projector, South floor 3): free at 16:00.

If you want video, the meeting could move to a day when Ember, Atlas or Grove is free, or the attendees' schedules could change. Tell me which option you prefer and I'll book it.

I booked the "Launch retro" for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 (headquarters time) in Ember (R-EMBER), booking ID BK-9901.

- **Attendees:** Ana Ruiz, Ben Okafor, Chloe Marsh, Dev Patel and Eli Novak are all free for the full hour.
- **Room:** Ember is on North floor 0, seats 6, and has video conferencing for the remote stakeholder.

This was the only slot that worked. The attendees' only shared free window is 13:00–14:30, and Ember is the only room with video conferencing and enough seats that is free then. The other candidate rooms were Atlas (busy 13:30 onward) and Grove (booked all day).

I assumed headquarters time is America/New_York, since all five calendars are in that zone.

- The only 60-minute windows when all five are free are **09:30–10:30** and **16:00–17:00**.

**Rooms with video conferencing and at least 5 seats:**
- **Ember** (North, floor 0, 6 seats): booked 09:00–10:30 for the Support huddle, and 15:00–17:00 for Team lunch. Not free at either window.
- **Atlas** (North, floor 2, 8 seats): booked 09:00–11:00 and 13:30–17:00 (Roadmap review). Not free at either window.
- **Grove** (North, floor 3, 10 seats): booked all day for the Leadership offsite (08:30–17:30).

**Options if you can relax the video requirement:**
- **16:00–17:00** looks open in Dune (North, floor 1, 6 seats), Lark (South, floor 2, 5 seats), Kite (South, floor 3, 16 seats), Cedar (North, floor 3, 12 seats) and Maple (South, floor 0, 6 seats). None of these has video conferencing, so the remote stakeholder would need another way to join.

Tell me which option you'd like and I'll book it. Alternatively, I can look at other dates if the video requirement is firm.

I booked the Cross-site sync for 2026-11-03 from 10:00 to 11:00 (headquarters time, New York), in room Ember (R-EMBER). Booking ID: BK-9901.

- **Priya Nair (New York):** 10:00–11:00 local, within her working hours.
- **Tom Hale (London):** 15:00–16:00 local, within his working hours.

content.text:
The Cross-site sync is booked for 2026-11-03 from 10:00 to 11:00 New York time (booking BK-9901) in Ember (R-EMBER, North building, floor 0). Priya Nair, Tom Hale and Sven Berg are all invited.

This was the only slot that worked. Because Sven's Berlin working day ends at 11:00 New York time, the common window was 09:00–11:00, and Priya had a standup from 09:00 to 09:30 and Sven had one from 09:30 to 10:00. That left 10:00–11:00 as the only hour all three could make.

In local time, the meeting is 15:00–16:00 in London and 16:00–17:00 in Berlin, which is inside each person's working hours.

Ember seats 6 and has video conferencing. Birch, Haven, Atlas and Grove also have video conferencing and enough seats, but they were already booked at that time.

Meeting times are in headquarters time, which is New York (UTC-5). All three must be free and inside their own local 09:00-17:00 working hours, and the room must seat all three and have video conferencing. Meetings start on the hour or half hour.

I booked the 'Process workshop' for 2026-11-03 from 10:30 to 12:00 in Cedar (booking BK-9901). Ana, Ben, Chloe and Dev are all free for that slot.

- **Room:** Cedar, North building, 3rd floor. It has a whiteboard and a projector, and its capacity of 12 is above the four attendees.
- **Policy:** The 15-minute room buffer is respected. The nearest bookings in Cedar are the 09:00–10:00 standup overflow and the 14:00–15:00 board prep, so there is a gap on both sides.
- **Time zone:** I assumed headquarters time matches the attendees' calendar time zone (America/New_York, UTC−5), since the system didn't state it.

Cedar is the only room that fit all the constraints. The other whiteboard rooms were blocked by existing bookings or the buffer rule. The attendees' only common free windows were 09:30–12:00 and 13:00–14:30. The room is larger than four seats, so if you wanted a room sized closer to four, let me know and I can look at alternatives.

I booked the Process workshop in Cedar (R-CEDAR, North building, 3rd floor) on 2026-11-03 from 10:30 to 12:00, booking ID BK-9901. The booking is confirmed for Ana, Ben, Chloe and Dev.

Cedar has a whiteboard and seats 12, so it meets the seating requirement. It also clears the 15-minute room buffer from the neighbouring Cedar bookings at 09:00–10:00 and 14:00–15:00.

Only this slot worked. The 13:00–14:30 window was blocked by room buffers in every whiteboard room, and after 15:30 Dev is busy until 17:00.

I took all four calendars to be in the same headquarters time (their listed UTC-5 offset), since the calendar times and the booking times were compared on that basis.

- **Room fit:** Cedar has a whiteboard. It seats 12, so it has room for the four attendees, though it is larger than needed. No room with exactly four seats and a whiteboard was free at a suitable time.

- **Times:** I treated the calendars' America/New_York time (UTC-5) as headquarters time. All four are free from 09:30 to 12:00 and 13:00 to 14:30, so 10:30 is the only valid 90-minute start that also gives the room the required buffer.

I booked the Process workshop for 2026-11-03 from 10:30 to 12:00 in Cedar (booking BK-9901). Cedar is on the 3rd floor of the North building, seats 12, and has a whiteboard and projector.

- **Attendees:** Ana Ruiz, Ben Okafor, Chloe Marsh and Dev Patel are all free for the full slot, and it sits inside everyone's working hours.
- **Room buffer:** Cedar's previous booking ends at 10:00, so the 15-minute turnaround gap under policy SP-2026-4 is met.
- **Other options:** No other room with a whiteboard and at least four seats worked. Birch, Dune, Fern and Lark each had a booking that broke the buffer or clashed with someone's calendar.
- **Time zone:** I assumed headquarters time matches the attendees' calendars (America/New_York, UTC-5).

transcript.content: Today is 2026-11-02. Book a 90-minute 'Process workshop' on 2026-11-03 for Ana Ruiz (P-ANA), Ben Okafor (P-BEN), Chloe Marsh (P-CHL) and Dev Patel (P-DEV). All four must be free within their working hours, the room must have a whiteboard and seat four, and the booking must follow the room-booking policy. Use headquarters time. Meetings start on the hour or half hour.

I booked the 90-minute "Process workshop" for 2026-11-03 from 10:30 to 12:00 in Cedar (booking BK-9901). The booking was confirmed.

- **Attendees:** Ana Ruiz, Ben Okafor, Chloe Marsh and Dev Patel are all free for the full slot and within their 09:00–17:00 working hours.
- **Room:** Cedar is on the North building's 3rd floor. It has a whiteboard and seats 12, which covers the four attendees.
- **Policy:** The room has no other booking within the 15-minute turnaround buffer on either side (the nearest bookings end at 10:00 and start at 14:00).

I checked the other options before choosing this one. The only other free windows were 13:00–14:30, but that clashes with the room buffer or room availability in every whiteboard room, so Cedar at 10:30 was the only fit.

I assumed headquarters time matches the attendees' calendar time (America/New_York, UTC−5), since all four are in that zone.

content.text:
I booked the 'Process workshop' in Cedar (R-CEDAR) on 2026-11-03 from 10:30 to 12:00 (booking BK-9901). All four attendees are free for the slot.

- **Why this slot:** Ana, Ben, Chloe and Dev share only two free windows that day: 09:30–12:00 and 13:00–14:30. The 13:00 window had no room with a whiteboard and four seats that met the 15-minute turnaround rule. At 10:30, Cedar is the only room that fits.
- **Room:** Cedar seats 12, has a whiteboard and a projector, and its earlier booking ends at 10:00, which leaves the required buffer.
- **Time zone:** I treated headquarters time as the same as the attendees' calendars (UTC-5, America/New_York), since all four are on that offset.

The booking was created with no catering order and no recurrence.

I booked the 'Process workshop' in Cedar (R-CEDAR) on 2026-11-03 from 10:30 to 12:00. The booking is confirmed as BK-9901.

- **Attendees:** Ana Ruiz, Ben Okafor, Chloe Marsh and Dev Patel are all free for the full slot.
- **Room:** Cedar is on floor 3 of the North building, has a whiteboard, and holds 12, so it fits four people.
- **Policy:** The booking keeps the 15-minute turnaround gap from the other Cedar bookings (09:00–10:00 and 14:00–15:00).

Cedar was the only room that met all the constraints. Every other whiteboard room was taken or too close to another booking. The attendees' calendars and the bookings are in local time, which is UTC-5 for all four, so I treated headquarters time as the same. The booking was confirmed under Ana Ruiz as organiser.

content.text:
The 'Process workshop' is booked for 2026-11-03 from 10:30 to 12:00 in Cedar (R-CEDAR, floor 3, North building). Booking ID is BK-9901.

- **Attendees:** Ana Ruiz, Ben Okafor, Chloe Marsh and Dev Patel are all free for the full slot.
- **Room:** Cedar has a whiteboard and projector. It seats 12, more than the four required.
- **Policy:** It meets the 15-minute room buffer (SP-2026-4) with the nearest bookings in Cedar at 09:00–10:00 and 14:00–15:00.

I treated headquarters time as UTC−5 (America/New_York), since all four calendars use that offset. The only other 90-minute slot that worked for everyone was 13:00–14:30, but no whiteboard room was free then because of the buffer.

I booked the 'Process workshop' in Cedar (R-CEDAR) on 2026-11-03 from 10:30 to 12:00 (booking BK-9901). The booking is confirmed for Ana Ruiz, Ben Okafor, Chloe Marsh and Dev Patel.

- **Room:** Cedar is on floor 3 of the North building, has a whiteboard, and holds 12 people, so it fits four. It is the only room that met all the requirements with the 15-minute turnaround buffer.
- **Attendees:** All four are free for the full 90 minutes and within their 09:00–17:00 working hours.
- **Other options:** Birch, Fern, Dune and Lark were ruled out by the buffer rule or by someone's calendar. Grove has a leadership offsite all day.

I treated the calendar times as headquarters time because all four attendees are on the same UTC-5 offset. The booking response shows no catering order and no recurrence.

content.text:
I booked the 'Process workshop' in Cedar (R-CEDAR), floor 3 of the North building, on 2026-11-03 from 10:30 to 12:00 headquarters time. It is confirmed as booking BK-9901, and Ana Ruiz, Ben Okafor, Chloe Marsh and Dev Patel are the attendees.

- **Why this time:** All four are free only in the 09:30–12:00 and 13:00–14:30 windows. Dev Patel is busy from 14:30 to 17:00, so the 13:00 option couldn't fit a 90-minute meeting.
- **Why Cedar:** It has a whiteboard and seats 12, which is more than the four required. The other whiteboard rooms that could fit the slot were Birch, Dune, Fern, Lark and Grove, and each one clashed with an existing booking or the 15-minute turnaround buffer.
- **Policy:** The room has no other booking within 15 minutes of either end of this slot, and no attendee is double-booked.

I assumed headquarters time is the same as the New York time shown in the calendars (UTC−5), since all four attendees are on that offset.

I booked the Process workshop for 2026-11-03 from 10:30 to 12:00 in Cedar (R-CEDAR, 4th floor, North block). Reference: BK-9901.

- **Attendees:** Ana Ruiz, Ben Okafor, Chloe Marsh and Dev Patel are all free for the full slot.
- **Room:** Cedar has a whiteboard and seats 12, so it fits four people.
- **Policy:** The booking keeps the 15-minute turnaround gap from the neighbouring Cedar booking at 09:00–10:00.

I chose 10:30 because it was the only slot that worked. The other rooms with a whiteboard and capacity for four either had a booking that broke the 15-minute gap or were occupied during the common free windows (09:30–12:00 and 13:00–14:30).

I took the times as headquarters time, which I assumed matches the attendees' America/New_York calendars. Let me know if headquarters runs on a different zone.

The Process workshop is booked for 2026-11-03 from 10:30 to 12:00 in Cedar (booking ref BK-9901), with Ana, Ben, Chloe and Dev as attendees.

- **Why this slot:** It's the only 90-minute window where all four are free within working hours and the room is free. The other 90-minute option, 13:00–14:30, is blocked by a 14:30 meeting for three of the four people.
- **Room:** Cedar has a whiteboard and seats 12, so it meets the "seats four" requirement with room to spare. Birch and Fern also have whiteboards and seat four, but both were booked too close to the morning window to fit the 15-minute turnaround rule.
- **Policy:** The booking keeps the 15-minute turnaround gap from the other Cedar bookings, and no attendee is double-booked.

I assumed headquarters time is the same as the America/New_York time shown on the calendars.

I booked the Process workshop for 2026-11-03 from 10:30 to 12:00 in Cedar (R-CEDAR, 4th floor, North block). The booking reference is BK-9901 and its state is confirmed.

- **Attendees:** Ana Ruiz, Ben Okafor, Chloe Marsh and Dev Patel are all free for the whole slot.
- **Room:** Cedar has a whiteboard and seats 12, so it meets the four-seat minimum you can use as a floor. It is the only room that fits. The other whiteboard rooms were blocked by existing bookings or by the 15-minute turnaround buffer.

- **Whiteboard:** yes.

Cedar was the only room that met every requirement:

content.text:
I booked the Process workshop for 2026-11-03 from 10:30 to 12:00 in Cedar (booking BK-9901). Cedar is on North floor 3, seats 12, and has a whiteboard. Ana, Ben, Chloe and Dev are all free for the full slot.

- **Why this slot:** It is the earliest 90-minute window that fits everyone's calendar and the room's schedule. The room buffer is 15 minutes, so Cedar's 09:00–10:00 booking forces a start no earlier than 10:15, and the 10:30 start keeps to the half-hour rule.
- **Other rooms:** Birch, Dune, Fern and Lark were ruled out because their existing bookings or the 15-minute buffer left no valid 90-minute gap that also fit the attendees' free time.
- **Time zone:** All four calendars are in America/New_York (UTC−5), and I treated headquarters time as the same zone. If HQ is in a different zone, the time should be checked.

I booked the Process workshop for Tuesday 2026-11-03, 10:30–12:00 headquarters time, in Cedar (booking BK-9901). Ana, Ben, Chloe and Dev are all free for the full slot.

- **Room:** Cedar is on North floor 3 (east wing). It has a whiteboard and a projector, and seats 12, so it meets the four-seat requirement.

No other room on the day met all the requirements (whiteboard, four seats, room buffer, and all four attendees free for 90 minutes).

content.text:
I booked the Process workshop for 2026-11-03 from 10:30 to 12:00 in Cedar (booking BK-9901). The booking is confirmed for Ana Ruiz, Ben Okafor, Chloe Marsh and Dev Patel.

Cedar is on the North campus, 3rd floor. It seats 12 and has a whiteboard and projector.

I checked the following before booking:
- **Attendees:** All four are free from 10:30 to 12:00. Dev is busy from 14:30 onward, which leaves only the morning and early-afternoon windows.
- **Room policy (SP-2026-4):** The room must have a 15-minute gap from other bookings. Cedar has a 09:00–10:00 booking, so the 10:30 start clears it.
- **Room choice:** Other whiteboard rooms were ruled out by existing bookings or the 15-minute gap. Grove is booked all day, and Birch, Dune, Fern and Lark each conflict with the 90-minute slot or the gap rule.

I booked the 'Process workshop' for 2026-11-03 from 10:30 to 12:00 (headquarters time) in Cedar (R-CEDAR, Floor 3, North). Booking ID: BK-9901.

- **Attendees:** Ana Ruiz, Ben Okafor, Chloe Marsh and Dev Patel are all free for the full slot.
- **Room:** Cedar has a whiteboard and a 12-seat capacity, so it fits four.
- **Policy:** The 15-minute room turnaround gap is respected. Cedar's nearest bookings are 09:00–10:00 and 14:00–15:00.

Cedar was the only room that fit. The four attendees' only common free windows were 09:30–12:00 and 13:00–14:30. Every other room with a whiteboard and four or more seats was either occupied or didn't leave the 15-minute gap.

I assumed headquarters time matches the New York time (UTC−5) shown on all four calendars. Please confirm that if HQ is in a different zone.

I booked the Process workshop for 2026-11-03 from 10:30 to 12:00 in Cedar (R-CEDAR, North building, 3rd floor). The booking ID is BK-9901, and it is confirmed for Ana, Ben, Chloe and Dev.

- **Why this slot:** It is the only time that works for all four within their 09:00–17:00 hours, with no conflicts. The afternoon gap (13:00–14:30) had no room that met the whiteboard and capacity needs without breaking the 15-minute room buffer.
- **Room:** Cedar has a whiteboard and projector. It seats 12, so it covers the four attendees. It was the only room that fit both the policy buffer and the whiteboard requirement at this time. If you meant a room seating exactly four, none was available.
- **Time zone:** I treated headquarters time as America/New_York, which matches all four attendees' calendars (UTC−5). If HQ is in a different zone, the time would need adjusting.

I booked the Process workshop for 2026-11-03 from 10:30 to 12:00 in Cedar (booking BK-9901). Cedar is on North floor 3 and has a whiteboard and 12 seats.

- **Attendees:** Ana Ruiz, Ben Okafor, Chloe Marsh and Dev Patel are all free for the full slot and within their 09:00–17:00 working hours.
- **Policy:** The 15-minute room buffer is respected. The earlier Cedar booking ends at 10:00 and the later one starts at 14:00.
- **Time zone:** I assumed headquarters time matches the attendees' calendars, which are in America/New_York (UTC−5).

This was the only slot that fit. The attendees' common free windows are 09:30–12:00 and 13:00–14:30, and every other room with a whiteboard and at least four seats was either occupied or would break the buffer.

I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (booking BK-9901). Attendees are Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor.

- **Room:** Ember is on the ground floor of the North building, seats 6 and has a projector and video conferencing. The policy requires ground-floor rooms for external guests.
- **Policy:** The slot stays clear of the 12:00–13:00 blackout.
- **Guest window:** 13:30–14:30 falls inside the Northwind guest's 10:00–15:00 availability.
- **Calendars:** Ben's 1:1 ends at 13:30 and Ana's roadmap review starts at 14:30, so neither clashes.

This was the only feasible slot. The other ground-floor rooms either seat fewer than 3 people (Nook, Opal) or are busy during the guest's window (Maple, from 14:30 onward).

I assumed headquarters time matches the New York time zone that Ana's and Ben's calendars use (UTC-5). The tools didn't state it explicitly, so please confirm.

The guest isn't on any calendar, so they aren't listed as an attendee. You'll need to send them the details separately.

I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (booking BK-9901). Ana and Ben are the attendees.

- **Why Ember:** The external guest means the room must be on floor 0 under the room-booking policy. Ember is on the ground floor of the North building, seats 6, and has a projector and video conferencing. Nook and Opal are ground-floor too but only seat 2.
- **Why this slot:** It was the only 60-minute window that worked. It clears Ben's 13:00–13:30 1:1, Ana's 14:30 commitment, the 12:00–13:00 blackout, and Ember's other bookings. It also falls inside the guest's 10:00–15:00 window.
- **Time zone:** I treated the booking times as New York time, the zone Ana's and Ben's calendars use. If headquarters runs on a different clock, the slot needs checking.
- **Guest:** The guest isn't on the booking, as you asked. Their name wasn't provided, so I couldn't add it.

I booked the 90-minute "Process workshop" for 2026-11-03 from 10:30 to 12:00 (headquarters time) in **Cedar** (North building, 3rd floor). It is confirmed as booking BK-9901, with Ana, Ben, Chloe and Dev as attendees.

Cedar seats 12, so it meets the four-seat requirement, and it has a whiteboard. It was the only room and slot that worked:
- All four attendees are free from 10:30 to 12:00. Each has a standup in the morning and a lunch from 12:00 to 13:00, and Dev is busy from 14:30 onward.
- The policy's 15-minute room turnaround buffer is respected. Cedar's previous booking ends at 10:00 and its next starts at 14:00.
- The other whiteboard rooms with enough seats were blocked by existing bookings or the buffer.

I assumed headquarters time matches the attendees' local time (America/New_York, UTC-5), since all four are in that zone and the tool didn't give an HQ offset.

I booked the 'Process workshop' for 2026-11-03 from 10:30 to 12:00 (headquarters time) in Cedar (R-CEDAR, North building, floor 3). The booking ID is BK-9901.

- **Attendees:** Ana Ruiz, Ben Okafor, Chloe Marsh and Dev Patel are all free for the full slot.
- **Room:** Cedar has a whiteboard and seats 12, so it fits four people. It is the only room that met every constraint. Every other whiteboard room was either taken or would have broken the 15-minute turnaround buffer.
- **Policy:** The room has no other booking within 15 minutes of either end.

I assumed headquarters time is the same as the attendees' calendar time (America/New_York, UTC-5). All four calendars use that zone, so no conversion was needed.

I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (R-EMBER), booking ID BK-9901. Attendees are Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor.

- **Why this slot:** Ember is the only room that fits every constraint. It is on the ground floor, which the external-guest rule requires, and it seats 6. Its other ground-floor options were too small (Nook and Opal seat 2) or already booked during the guest's 10:00–15:00 window (Maple). The slot also clears the 12:00–13:00 blackout and both employees' calendars.
- **Guest:** The guest is not on the booking, as you asked. Please confirm their attendance separately, since the booking system has no record of them.
- **Time zone assumption:** I treated headquarters time as the same as the employees' calendar time (America/New_York, UTC-5). The tools did not state the headquarters zone. If it differs, the slot needs to be checked again.

I booked the Process workshop for 2026-11-03 from 10:30 to 12:00 in Cedar (booking BK-9901). The attendees are Ana Ruiz, Ben Okafor, Chloe Marsh and Dev Patel.

- **Why this slot:** It is the only time that works for all four. Their combined free time is 09:30–12:00 and 13:00–14:30, and the other 90-minute options either overlap a meeting or are too close to one for the room buffer.
- **Why Cedar:** It is the only room with a whiteboard and at least four seats that also meets the policy's 15-minute room buffer. It seats 12, so it is larger than needed.
- **Time zone:** I treated headquarters time as America/New_York (UTC−5), the zone shown on all four calendars. The system does not state the headquarters zone, so please confirm this matches.

content.text:
The Northwind demo is booked for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (booking BK-9901). Attendees are Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor.

I picked Ember because the policy requires meetings with external guests to be on the ground floor. Ember is also the only ground-floor room that seats three and is free in the guest's 10:00–15:00 window. The slot avoids the 12:00–13:00 blackout, Ben's 1:1 (ends 13:30) and Ana's roadmap review (starts 14:30).

The Northwind guest is not on the booking, since they have no calendar here. You'll need to tell them the room and time, and arrange their entry to Ember (North building, ground floor, east wing).

content.text:
I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (booking BK-9901). Attendees are Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor.

I picked this slot because it was the only one that fit every constraint:
- **Guest window:** the meeting falls inside the guest's 10:00–15:00 availability.
- **Room size:** Ember seats 6, enough for all three people.
- **External-guest floor rule:** Ember is on floor 0, as policy requires for external guests.
- **Midday blackout:** the meeting avoids the 12:00–13:00 window.
- **Calendars:** Ana and Ben are both free for the full hour. Ben's 1:1 ends at 13:30 and Ana's next commitment starts at 14:30.

No other slot worked. The morning was blocked in Ember by the support huddle until 11:30, and any slot that started at 11:30 or later ran into the blackout. Maple, the only other ground-floor room that fits three people, was booked from 09:30 to 12:00 and again from 13:00 to 14:30, leaving no full hour inside the guest window.

The guest is not on the booking, since they have no calendar here. You'll need to tell them the room and time directly.

content.text:
I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 (headquarters time) in Ember (R-EMBER), booking ID BK-9901.

- **Attendees:** Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor. The external Northwind guest is not on the booking, as you asked.
- **Room:** Ember is on the ground floor, which the policy requires for meetings with external guests. It seats 6, so it fits all three people.
- **Policy:** the meeting stays clear of the 12:00–13:00 midday blackout.
- **Guest window:** 13:30–14:30 falls inside the guest's 10:00–15:00 availability.

I was the only one who could make this work: Ana's calendar blocks 14:30 onward, Ben has a 1:1 from 13:00 to 13:30, and the other ground-floor rooms were either too small or already taken. I assumed headquarters time matches the Eastern offset (UTC−5) on Ana's and Ben's calendars. If headquarters runs on a different clock, the slot will need moving.

content.text:
The Northwind demo is booked for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (booking BK-9901), with Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor as attendees.

- **Room:** Ember is on the ground floor of the North building and seats 6, so it fits all three people. The policy requires external guests to be on floor 0.
- **Guest window:** 13:30–14:30 falls inside the Northwind guest's 10:00–15:00 availability.
- **Policy:** the meeting doesn't touch the 12:00–13:00 midday blackout.
- **Attendees:** Ana and Ben are both free for the full slot.

This was the only slot that worked. Ember's other free time (11:30–14:30) is either inside the blackout or too short to leave room for both ends, and the other ground-floor room that seats three or more (Maple) is booked until 14:30 on that day.

I assumed headquarters time matches the employees' calendar time zone (UTC-5). The booking was accepted, so the system agreed with that.

content.text:
I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (R-EMBER, North building, floor 0), booking ID BK-9901.

- **Attendees:** Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor. The Northwind guest is not on the booking, as you asked.
- **Why this slot:** The external guest requires a ground-floor room under the policy (SP-2026-5), and Ember is the only ground-floor room that seats three and is free in the guest's 10:00–15:00 window. Its morning is taken by the Support huddle, and Maple (the other ground-floor option) is busy at every usable time. The slot also avoids the 12:00–13:00 blackout and both employees' calendar conflicts.
- **Assumption:** I treated headquarters time as the same as the employees' calendar time (UTC-5), since both calendars use that offset. The booking was confirmed, so the system accepted that.

content.text:
I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 headquarters time in Ember (room R-EMBER, booking BK-9901). Attendees are Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor.

- **Why this slot:** The room is on ground floor (floor 0), as the external-guest rule requires. It seats 6, which covers all three people. It avoids the 12:00–13:00 blackout. It also falls inside the guest's 10:00–15:00 window and is free for both employees.
- **Why not earlier:** Ember is booked 09:30–11:30 that morning, and the other ground-floor room with enough seats, Maple, is busy until 12:00 and again 13:00–14:30.
- **Assumption:** I treated headquarters time as the same as the employees' calendar time (America/New_York, UTC−5). If HQ is in a different time zone, the slot needs checking against the guest's window.
- The guest is not on the booking, since they have no calendar in the system.

I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (booking BK-9901), with Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor as attendees.

Ember is the only room that fits every constraint:
- **Floor 0:** the policy requires external-guest meetings to be on the ground floor.
- **Capacity:** it seats 6, enough for the two employees plus the guest.
- **Blackout:** the 12:00–13:00 blackout is avoided.
- **Availability:** both employees and the room are free for the slot.
- **Guest window:** the meeting falls inside the guest's 10:00–15:00 window.

The guest isn't on the booking, since they have no calendar here. I assumed headquarters time matches the -5 UTC offset on Ana's and Ben's calendars.

content.text:
I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (R-EMBER, North building, ground floor, 6 seats). Booking ID is BK-9901, and it's confirmed with Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor as attendees.

- **Why this slot:** The guest's window is 10:00–15:00, and the policy blocks 12:00–13:00. Ben has a 1:1 from 13:00 to 13:30, and Ana has a block from 14:30. That leaves 13:30–14:30 as the only slot that fits all three.
- **Why Ember:** External guests require a ground-floor room, and the room has to seat three. Ember is the only ground-floor room that fits both conditions and is free at that time. Maple, the other option, was booked.
- **Assumption:** I treated headquarters time as the same as the employees' calendar time (America/New_York, UTC-5). The tools didn't state HQ's time zone explicitly.
- **Not done:** The guest isn't on the booking, since they have no calendar here. Ember's booking contact is facilities-north if the guest's details need to go to them.

content.text:
I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 (headquarters time) in room Ember (R-EMBER), booking ID BK-9901. Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor are the attendees.

- **Guest window:** the slot falls inside the Northwind guest's 10:00–15:00 availability.
- **Policy:** Ember is on floor 0, which external meetings require. It seats 6, so it fits all three. The slot avoids the 12:00–13:00 blackout.
- **Calendars:** Ben's 1:1 ends at 13:30 and Ana's next busy block starts at 14:30, so both are free for the full hour.

The only room that fit was Ember. Maple is also on floor 0 but is busy until 12:00 and then in the 13:00 block, so it could not host a slot before 15:00.

I assumed headquarters time matches the employees' calendar time zone (America/New_York, UTC−5), since no headquarters offset was given. If headquarters is on a different time zone, the slot needs to be checked again.

I assumed headquarters time matches the calendar times for Ana and Ben (both show UTC-5). If headquarters is on a different offset, the time will need to be moved.

content.text:
I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (R-EMBER), booking ID BK-9901. The attendees are Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor.

- **Guest window:** 13:30–14:30 falls inside the Northwind guest's 10:00–15:00 availability.
- **Policy:** Ember is on the ground floor, as the external-guest rule requires. The meeting stays clear of the 12:00–13:00 blackout.
- **Capacity:** Ember seats 6, enough for the three of you.
- **Calendars:** Ana and Ben are both free for the full hour.

Ember was the only room that worked. The other ground-floor room that seats three or more, Maple, is booked until 12:00 and then again from 13:00.

The booking system records the time in headquarters time, and I assumed that matches the New York time on Ana's and Ben's calendars (both UTC-5). If HQ is on a different offset, the time would need checking.

content.text:
I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (R-EMBER), booking ID BK-9901. Attendees are Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor.

- **Guest access:** Ember is on the ground floor, which the policy requires for external guests. It seats 6, enough for all three.
- **Policy:** The meeting stays clear of the 12:00–13:00 midday blackout.
- **Why this slot:** It was the only option. Ember is busy 09:30–11:30 and 14:30–16:00. Maple, the other ground-floor room that fits three, is busy 09:30–12:00 and 13:00–14:30. Any other slot in the guest's 10:00–15:00 window hits a blackout or an attendee conflict.
- **Assumption:** I treated headquarters time as UTC−5, the same offset as Ana's and Ben's calendars. If HQ is on a different offset, the times would need rechecking.

The guest is not on the invite, since they have no calendar here. Their name isn't known to me, so please add them to the invite yourself.

I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 headquarters time in Ember (R-EMBER), reservation BK-9901.

- **Attendees:** Ana Ruiz (P-ANA) and Ben Okafor (P-BEN). The Northwind guest is not on the booking.
- **Room:** Ember is on the ground floor, which the policy requires for meetings with external guests. It seats 6, so it fits all three people.
- **Policy:** The meeting stays clear of the 12:00–13:00 midday blackout.
- **Guest window:** 13:30–14:30 falls inside the guest's 10:00–15:00 availability.
- **Calendars:** Both employees are free for the whole slot.

I treated headquarters time as America/New_York, the zone both employees' calendars use. If headquarters is on a different clock, the slot would need to move.

content.text:
I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (booking BK-9901), with Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor as the attendees.

- **Room:** Ember is on the ground floor, which the policy requires for meetings with external guests. It seats 6, so it fits all three people.
- **Guest window:** The 13:30–14:30 slot falls inside the guest's 10:00–15:00 availability.
- **Policy:** The meeting does not overlap the 12:00–13:00 quiet window.
- **Calendars:** Ben's 1:1 ends at 13:30 and Ana's roadmap review starts at 14:30, so both are free for the full hour.

This was the only option that worked. The other ground-floor rooms were either too small (Nook and Opal seat 2) or already booked during the guest's window (Maple). Ember's other bookings that day sit outside this slot.

I assumed headquarters time matches the New York time on the calendars (UTC-5). The guest's name isn't recorded in the booking, since the system only takes employee attendees.

transcript.content: Today is 2026-11-02. Book a 60-minute 'Northwind demo' on 2026-11-03 for Ana Ruiz (P-ANA), Ben Okafor (P-BEN) and one external guest from Northwind, who can only attend between 10:00 and 15:00 headquarters time. The room must seat all three and the booking must follow the room-booking policy. Book only the two employees as attendees; the guest has no calendar here. Meetings start on the hour or half hour.

I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 headquarters time (booking BK-9901) in **Ember** (North block, ground floor, seats 6, video conference and projector).

- **Attendees:** Ana Ruiz (P-ANA) and Ben Okafor (P-BEN). The Northwind guest is not booked, as you asked.
- **Why this slot:** Ember is the only room that works. The policy requires external-guest meetings to be on the ground floor, and Maple, the other ground-floor room that seats three, is booked from 09:30 to 12:00 and again from 13:00 to 14:30. The slot also avoids the 12:00–13:00 quiet window, Ben's 13:00–13:30 1:1, and Ana's 14:30 commitment. It falls inside the guest's 10:00–15:00 availability.
- **Assumption:** I treated headquarters time as the same as the Eastern time zone that Ana's and Ben's calendars use. If HQ is on a different zone, the slot needs to be rechecked.

content.text:
I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (booking BK-9901). Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor are the attendees.

Ember is the only room that fits every constraint:
- **Ground floor:** the policy requires external-guest meetings on floor 0.
- **Capacity:** it seats 6, enough for the two employees and the guest.
- **Guest window:** the meeting ends at 14:30, inside the guest's 10:00–15:00 window.
- **Midday blackout:** it avoids 12:00–13:00.
- **Availability:** Ben is busy 13:00–13:30 and Ana is busy from 14:30, so 13:30–14:30 is the only start time that works for both.

The other ground-floor rooms were ruled out: Nook and Opal seat only 2, and Maple's only free slot after 14:30 would run past the guest's 15:00 cutoff.

The guest is not on the booking, since they have no calendar here.

The room must seat all three and the booking must follow the room-booking policy. Book only the two employees as attendees; the guest has no calendar here. Meetings start on the hour or half hour.

I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (R-EMBER), reference BK-9901. Attendees are Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor.

- **Guest fit:** Ember is on the ground floor, which the policy requires for external guests. It seats 6, so it fits all three people.
- **Policy:** the meeting clears the 12:00–13:00 blackout and sits inside the guest's 10:00–15:00 window.
- **Why this slot:** Ember is the only ground-floor room that fits three people and is free for a full hour. Maple is booked from 13:00 to 14:30 and is also in use in the morning. The morning slots clash with an existing Ember booking (09:30–11:30). Ana and Ben are both free from 13:30 to 14:30.
- **Time zone:** I assumed headquarters time matches the calendars' time zone (America/New_York, UTC-5). The system doesn't state the HQ zone explicitly, so please confirm.

The guest isn't on the booking, so their name and access will need arranging separately.

I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (booking BK-9901, confirmed).

- **Room:** Ember is on the ground floor (storey 0), seats 6, and is in the North block. The policy requires external guests to meet on the ground floor.
- **Attendees:** Ana Ruiz (P-ANA) and Ben Okafor (P-BEN). Both are free for the whole slot.
- **Guest window:** 13:30–14:30 falls within the Northwind guest's 10:00–15:00 availability.
- **Policy:** The meeting does not overlap the 12:00–13:00 midday blackout.

I assumed headquarters time matches the attendees' calendar time zone (America/New_York, UTC−5). Other ground-floor rooms were either too small or already booked across the usable window.

content.text:
I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (booking BK-9901), with Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor as the attendees.

- **Why Ember:** Meetings with external guests must be on the ground floor, and the room must seat at least three. Ember is on floor 0 and seats 6. Maple, the only other ground-floor room with enough seats, is booked until 14:30, which would run past the guest's 15:00 cutoff.
- **Policy:** The slot stays clear of the 12:00–13:00 quiet window.
- **Availability:** Both employees are free for the full hour, and the guest's 10:00–15:00 window is respected.
- **Only option:** Ember was the only slot that met all the constraints.

I took the headquarters time to match the calendars' time zone (America/New_York, UTC−5), since the system didn't state it. If HQ runs on a different clock, the slot would need checking.

The room must seat all three and the booking must follow the room-booking policy. Book only the two employees as attendees; the guest has no calendar here. Meetings start on the hour or half hour.

content.text:
I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (booking BK-9901). Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor are the attendees.

- **Room:** Ember is on the ground floor, which the policy requires for meetings with external guests. It seats 6, so it fits all three people.
- **Policy:** The slot does not overlap the 12:00–13:00 quiet window.
- **Guest window:** The meeting sits fully inside the Northwind guest's 10:00–15:00 availability.
- **Calendars:** Both employees are free for the whole slot.

Ember was the only option that met every constraint. The other ground-floor room that seats three or more, Maple, is fully booked across the window. I assumed headquarters time matches the New York time zone used on Ana's and Ben's calendars.

transcript.content: Today is 2026-11-02. I couldn't book this meeting. No room meets all the requirements on 2026-11-03.

- **Policy:** External guests must meet on the ground floor (storey 0), and no meeting may overlap the 12:00–13:00 blackout.
- **Capacity:** The room must seat at least 3. The only ground-floor rooms that do are Ember (North) and Maple (South), both with 6 seats.
- **Ember:** Booked 09:30–11:30 (Support huddle) and 14:30–16:00. The only free stretch is 11:30–12:30 or 13:00–14:30, and a 60-minute slot in either would overlap the blackout or fall outside the guest's 10:00–15:00 window.
- **Maple:** Booked 09:30–12:00 (weekly partner onboarding) and 13:00–14:30. Its only other free time is after 14:30, which runs past the guest's 15:00 cutoff.

Ana and Ben are both free for a 60-minute slot between 10:00 and 15:00 (Ben has a 13:00–13:30 1:1 and Ana has a 14:30–16:00 roadmap review), so the room is the constraint.

Options if you want to proceed:
- **Ask Facilities for an exception** to the ground-floor rule (facilities@example.com). Dune (North, storey 1, 6 seats) is free all day, so a 10:00–11:00 booking there would work if approved.
- **Ask the Northwind guest for a different time** on the same day. The room options above still don't fit, so this would need a room opening that the current bookings don't have.

I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (booking BK-9901). Attendees are Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor.

- **Room:** Ember is on the ground floor of the North building, seats 6, and has video conferencing and a projector. The ground-floor requirement applies because the Northwind guest is external.
- **Guest:** The external guest falls within their 10:00–15:00 window. They are not on the booking, as you asked.
- **Policy:** The meeting does not overlap the 12:00–13:00 blackout.

This was the only slot that worked. Ember and Maple are the only ground-floor rooms with enough seats, and Maple is busy from 09:30 to 12:00 and again from 13:00 to 14:30. Ember is busy from 09:30 to 11:30 and from 14:30 to 16:00. Ana is busy from 14:30 and Ben from 13:00 to 13:30.

I took the calendar times as headquarters time, since both attendees are on New York time (UTC−5) and the booking tool doesn't state a headquarters offset. If headquarters runs on a different offset, the slot needs rechecking.

- **Why this slot:** The Northwind guest needs a ground-floor room, and policy keeps external meetings on floor 0. That leaves only Ember and Maple (both seat 6). Maple is busy from 12:00 to 13:00 (blackout) and is booked until 14:30, so it had no slot inside the guest's 10:00–15:00 window. Ember's only free slot that avoids the blackout is 13:30–14:30.
- **Conflicts checked:** Ana and Ben are both free for the full hour. The meeting clears Ben's 1:1 (ends 13:30) and Ana's roadmap review (starts 14:30).
- **Assumption:** I treated headquarters time as the same as the calendars' time zone (UTC-5), since both attendees are on that offset.

The room is ground floor and seats 6. The booking has no catering or equipment requests. The guest is not on the booking, as you asked.

I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (booking BK-9901). Attendees are Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor.

- **Why Ember:** The Northwind guest means the room must be on ground floor (floor 0). Of those rooms, only Ember and Maple seat three or more. Nook and Opal seat two. Ember is the only one that fits the guest's 10:00–15:00 window. Maple had no free hour inside that window that avoids the 12:00–13:00 blackout.
- **Why 13:30:** It is the only 60-minute slot in the guest's window that Ember, Ana and Ben are all free for without touching the midday blackout. Ben has a 1:1 until 13:30, and Ana has a roadmap review from 14:30.
- **Assumption:** I treated headquarters time as the same as the calendars' time zone (America/New_York, UTC-5). The tools did not give an explicit HQ offset. If HQ is in a different zone, the time needs rechecking against the guest's window.
- The guest is not on the booking, since they have no calendar here. Ember has catering, and the guest may need to be registered with building reception.

I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (booking BK-9901), with Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor as attendees.

- **Room:** Ember is on the ground floor of the North building, seats 6, and has video conferencing and a projector. Ground floor is required because the Northwind guest is external.
- **Guest window:** 13:30–14:30 falls inside the guest's 10:00–15:00 availability.
- **Policy:** the meeting clears the 12:00–13:00 blackout window.
- **Calendars:** both Ana and Ben are free for the slot.

The only slot that fit every constraint was this one. The other ground-floor room that seats three or more, Maple, is booked until 12:00 and then again from 13:00 to 14:30, so it had no 60-minute gap inside the guest's window. The two small ground-floor rooms, Nook and Opal, seat only 2.

I treated headquarters time as the same as the New York time shown in Ana's and Ben's calendars (UTC−5). If headquarters is on a different time zone, the slot would need to be rechecked.

I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (booking BK-9901). Ana and Ben are the attendees.

Ember is the only room that fits every constraint:
- **Ground floor:** the external guest requires a floor-0 room. Ember is on floor 0 in the North building.
- **Capacity:** it seats 6, which covers all three people.
- **Guest window:** the meeting ends at 14:30, inside the guest's 10:00–15:00 availability.
- **Blackout:** the 12:00–13:00 midday window is clear.
- **Attendees:** Ana and Ben are both free for the slot. Ben's 1:1 ends at 13:30 and Ana's roadmap review starts at 14:30.

Maple, the other ground-floor room with enough capacity, has no 60-minute gap that avoids the blackout. I assumed headquarters time matches the New York time used on the attendees' calendars (UTC−5).

The guest is not on the booking, so their name and the Northwind contact still need to be shared with whoever is hosting.

- **Room:** Ember is on the ground floor (floor 0) of the North building, which the external-guest rule requires. It seats 6, so it fits all three people.
- **Guest window:** The meeting falls inside the Northwind guest's 10:00–15:00 availability.
- **Policy:** It doesn't touch the 12:00–13:00 midday blackout.
- **Calendars:** Both employees are free for the whole slot. Ben's 1:1 ends at 13:30 and Ana's roadmap review starts at 14:30.

Ember was the only ground-floor room that could fit a 60-minute slot in the guest's window without hitting the blackout or another booking. The guest is not on the invite, since they have no calendar here.

I assumed headquarters time matches the New York time shown on the employees' calendars (UTC−5). The tools don't state the HQ offset, so please confirm the time before the guest is told.

I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (booking BK-9901), with Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor as attendees.

- **Room:** Ember is on floor 0, which the policy requires for meetings with external guests. It seats 6, so it fits all three people.
- **Policy:** The meeting sits entirely outside the 12:00–13:00 blackout.
- **Guest window:** 13:30–14:30 falls inside the Northwind guest's 10:00–15:00 availability.
- **Why this slot:** It was the only option that worked. Ember is busy at 09:30–11:30 and 14:30–16:00. Maple, the other ground-floor room that fits three, is booked 13:00–14:30. Ana is busy from 14:30, and Ben from 13:00 to 13:30.

The guest isn't on the booking since they have no calendar here, so you'll need to send them the invite separately.

- **Guest:** The guest isn't on the booking, since they have no calendar here. You'll need to send them the invitation separately.

The Northwind demo is booked for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (R-EMBER), booking ID BK-9901. Attendees are Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor.

Ember is the only option that fits every constraint:
- **Northwind guest:** Ember is on the ground floor (North building, floor 0), which the policy requires for external guests. It seats 6, so it fits all three people.
- **Guest window:** 13:30–14:30 is inside the guest's 10:00–15:00 availability.
- **Midday blackout:** the meeting avoids the 12:00–13:00 window.
- **Ana and Ben:** both are free for the slot. Ben's 1:1 ends at 13:30 and Ana's roadmap review starts at 14:30.

I treated headquarters time as UTC−5, the same offset as Ana's and Ben's calendars. The other ground-floor rooms were ruled out: Maple is booked or too late, and Nook and Opal are too small.

The guest is not on the invite, so the Northwind contact will need to be told the time separately.

I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 (headquarters time) in Ember (R-EMBER), booking ID BK-9901.

- **Attendees:** Ana Ruiz (P-ANA) and Ben Okafor (P-BEN). The Northwind guest is not added, as you asked.
- **Room:** Ember is on the ground floor of the North building and seats 6, so it fits all three people and meets the rule that external-guest meetings take place on floor 0.
- **Policy:** the slot avoids the 12:00–13:00 blackout.
- **Guest window:** 13:30–14:30 falls inside the guest's 10:00–15:00 availability.

This was the only option that worked. Ana and Ben are both free at 13:30 and Ember has no other booking until 14:30. The other ground-floor room that seats three, Maple, is booked until 14:30 that day, so it could not fit a 60-minute slot before 15:00.

content.text:
I booked the Northwind demo for 2026-11-03 from 13:30 to 14:30 in Ember (booking BK-9901). Attendees are Ana Ruiz and Ben Okafor.

Ember is the only room that fits all the constraints:
- **Ground floor:** the policy requires external guests to be in a floor-0 room, and Ember is on floor 0 in North.
- **Capacity:** it seats 6, enough for the two employees plus the guest.
- **Guest window:** the meeting falls within the guest's 10:00–15:00 availability.
- **Blackout:** it avoids the 12:00–13:00 blackout.
- **Calendars:** Ana and Ben are both free for the full hour. Ben's 1:1 ends at 13:30 and Ana's next commitment starts at 14:30.

Maple, the only other ground-floor room with enough seats, was booked from 09:30 to 12:00 and would have run past the guest's 15:00 limit. I assumed headquarters time matches the employees' America/New_York calendars.

The external guest from Northwind is not on the invite, since they have no calendar here. Ember has no catering order, so add one if the guest needs it.
